scope: Actual REA stdio MCP pseudocode of derived function/data projections, not original full ELF decompilation. Raw pinned ELF assembly and bounded native replay provide independent corroboration.

projections.provenance: Non-executable analysis projection of the fixed ELF. Selected FDE instruction bytes match original SHA-256. Referenced RIP data pages copied at original VAs. Synthetic ELF header and symbols; original sections, unwind metadata, dynamic relocations, and most callees omitted. Check every semantic conclusion against original assembly or isolated replay.

limitations: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.
Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
Pseudocode is Ghidra decompiler output, not original source and not text-equivalent to Hopper output.
External functions and functions without an analyzable body return null; other decompiler failures remain explicit.

important_projection_limitations: network_ecdh_selector pseudocode folds uninitialized globals to zero and removes membership search. Do not use its constant return as native behavior; original asm and actual native selector replay prove membership.
network_submit_task pseudocode calls address zero where original relative relocation slot 0xac1f2e8 resolves to 0x8f45610. No executable dispatch semantics are inferred from the zero.
